ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Child Care Program Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and funding of child care programs in Minnesota and other states to identify potential fraud and misuse of funds
questions: What are the financial transactions and funding sources for child care programs in Minnesota?
How are these funds being used and are there any signs of misuse?
ideas.insight: By following the money and analyzing financial transactions, we can identify potential fraud and misuse of funds in child care programs and hold those responsible accountable.
